summary: National Bankshares, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a semi-annual dividend of $0.75/share and renewal of a share repurchase authorization up to 250,000 shares from June 2026 through May 2027. The dividend payment is June 1, 2026, to holders of record May 26, 2026. The repurchase plan replaces the expiring plan and management retains discretion on execution. No advisor or board recommendation beyond the standard renewal. The aggregate repurchase represents about 4.2% of shares based on a rough float of ~6 million shares. Watch for actual repurchase pace vs. authorization and implications for capital allocation.
